segments.text:
THirdly, Consider also of the strange judgements, which in all ages have overtaken the most eminent of the enemies of the Scriptures. Besides Antiochus, Herod, Pilate, the persecuting emperours, especially Julian; Church Histories will acquaint you with multitudes more: Foxes book of Martyes will tell you of many undeniable remarkable judgements, on those adversaries of pure Religion the Papists, whose greatest wickedness is against these Scriptures; subjecting them to their Church, denying them to the people, and setting up their Traditions as equall to them.
Yea our own times have afforded us most evident examples. Sure God hath forced many of his enemies to acknowledg in their anguish the truth of his threatnings, and to cry out, as Julian, Vicisti Galilee.
